title: Terrain, Ecology, Flora, Settlement & Spatial Generator Library
objective: Build original generators that consume SSA/World/Environment/Scene semantics and output ARI-governed candidate resources: terrain fields/masks, erosion-style transforms, biome/ecology placement proposals, flora species/season/LOD variants, paths/roads, settlement/block layouts and reusable environmental variation. Suitability and procedural proposals must never silently become canonical distribution or World truth.

scope.purpose: Provide original deterministic environment/spatial production generators over existing semantic owner projections while preserving ARI candidate-resource governance and never promoting suitability/procedural output to canonical World distribution truth.
included: flora species, season and LOD variants
scope.completion_gate: Representative semantic environment inputs can deterministically produce inspectable candidate terrain/ecology/flora/path/settlement resource proposals with stable provenance and fail-closed invalid owner/reference states, while preserving ARI and SSA/World/Environment/Scene authority and never treating generated suitability or distribution proposals as canonical World truth.

selection_boundaries: PCA-01 and PCA-02 remain completed foundations; PCA-03 composes their recipe/graph/provenance contracts rather than replacing them.

SSA-01 remains semantic spatial authority-crosswalk authority; World/Reality, Scene, CreatureEcology and Asset remain canonical owners; ARI-02/ARI-03/ARI-11 retain resource identity, derivative-lineage and rights authority.

PCA-03 outputs candidate resources and ARI registration plans only; suitability/procedural placement never becomes canonical World/distribution/ecology truth and PCA-03 performs no ARI registration or canonical mutation.

Minimum GREEN was established at 80ffac6756794b4bb60ec55bcefe91a80bf4d519. Production was reopened only after terminal typecheck exposed literal-array widening; b5945e6b1357841067d9834b3529ce0b98b06bb7 changed only eight owner-domain arrays to `as const`, with no runtime behavior or authority expansion.

ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 was reconsulted after exact-tree publication. PCA-03 satisfies no rotation gate; MCS still requires PCA-04, PCA-15 and FOUR_LANE_RELEASE_BARRIER, so PCA-04 is the lawful next selected item.
PCA-04 is selected_not_started only; no branch or implementation authority exists until a later owner Continue governed-starts it. PCA-05+, MSAS, SMB-08 and downstream work remain unauthorized.

next_action: PCA-03 is closed. PCA-04 is selected_not_started after fresh ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.
